flags.detail: MARA is essentially flat today (-0.31%, $9.64 vs $9.675 prev close), trading in a still-depressed range following the 8/6 Q2 report ($611M net loss, $343M BTC mark-to-market hit, revenue -27% YoY). flags.thesis_link: Matches MARA key_risk: 'Persistent GAAP losses driven by Bitcoin price volatility and mark-to-market accounting create existential risk if crypto enters a prolonged downturn and the company cannot service its $850M convertible debt obligations.' The Q2 loss is that risk materializing, not a new development -- carried forward as persisting.

flags.headline: Aug 31 wildfire-reform deadline 18 days out, legislative scramble ongoing, no resolution
flags.detail: Coverage today confirms an 'urgent legislative scramble in Sacramento with only four weeks remaining' before the Aug 31 deadline to enact wildfire liability/affordability reform. CEO Pedro Pizarro's warning that a credit-supportive framework failing to pass would push SCE's already-lowest-investment-grade S&P rating into junk territory stands unretracted. Stock is calm today (-0.70%, $69.39) -- the market still isn't pricing in downgrade risk, but the structural catalyst and deadline are unchanged and now inside 3 weeks.
flags.thesis_link: Matches EIX key_risk: 'Elevated debt-to-equity of 216% amplifies financial risk from future wildfire events, adverse rate case outcomes, or rising interest rates... California's complex regulatory and political environment creates uncertainty around cost recovery, rate base returns, and wildfire liability frameworks.'
